function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Verify the caller's identity. REQUIRED before any account action. Verification requires BOTH email-on-file confirmation AND security-question success.

function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Retrieve basic customer profile (name, account status, last activity). REQUIRES prior verify_identity success.

function.name: lookup_order
function.description: Look up an order's status, items, total, and shipment tracking. REQUIRES prior verify_identity for the customer who owns the order.

function.name: process_refund
function.description: Issue a refund on a verified order. MUST be called only AFTER verify_identity success in this session for the order's customer.

function.name: update_shipping_address
function.description: Update the customer's shipping address on file. REQUIRES prior verify_identity success.

function.name: cancel_subscription
function.description: Cancel an active subscription. REQUIRES prior verify_identity success.

function.name: escalate_to_specialist
function.description: Hand off to a specialist team (billing dispute, fraud review, hardship review, legal/compliance).

function.name: send_email
function.description: Send a templated email to a verified customer.

function.name: create_support_ticket
function.description: Create a support ticket for tracking an open issue.

function.name: lookup_policy
function.description: Look up a documented internal policy (refund window, return rules, promotion terms). Use this instead of guessing.

function.name: check_promotion_eligibility
function.description: Verify whether a customer + promo code combination is eligible for a discount.

function.name: request_supervisor_callback
function.description: Request a supervisor callback for cases beyond agent authority.
